notes.title: Alpha #3 Update Available
notes.notes:
Attention to all DRIVES and SHOOTERS

The latest update is featuring new tracks, new vehicles and turrets

 INCREASED LEVEL CAP to 3, featuring the rail and hover turret and new race tracks with shootable short-cut gates.
 NEW VEHICLES - the Matador Heavy Truck and Maurador Trophy Truck are available. Both vehicles are bold and heavy compared to the more leightweight Kloss and Buggy.
 NEW INGAME COMMUNICATION PANEL for enhanced team coms.
 NEW WEAPON: Introducing ''The Health Gun',  Shooters can infuse Health to Drivers.
 CLAN FEATURE preview: each pair of players can assign a TEAM NAME and LOGO, from there team points will be accumulated for this team and can be ranked on the global TEAM leaderboard.
(Hint: Choose the ALIENWARE team to get access to the ALIENWARE branded buggy)


See you on the race tracks!

notes.title: Hot Fix Update 2
notes.notes:
Build Version 2014.03.27 #1:
- fixed crash bugs, epecially while loading and in situations when player leave the match during gameplay
- fixed killed messages, now you will see who has killed you more consistently
- slightly lower sniper power
- DRM signed
